reviews.review_description: Three years after Microsoft killed off the most loved social VR platform, The amazing SideQuest team brings life back to Altspace. First night open to the public was amazing, I saw and hugged so many people I hadn't seen for a long time, and got to meet lots of new amazing people.

I just had the best day in VR and the last time I felt like I had a good social VR experience like this  was back in the old AltspaceVR. I was also lucky enough to demo AltspaceVR before the release a week ago; it's great to see the progress even within the last few days. I was logged in on a Quest 2, and besides the teething glitches, I was amazed by the PCVR-like quality and performance to some of the worlds.

A great social VR app for older adults.

What makes this community special is the combination of a safer community, a great camera and filming system, and genuine diversity. It’s wonderful to see old AltspaceVR veterans reconnecting while welcoming newcomers from Bigscreen, Rec Room, and Spatial IO. Different platforms, different experiences, but one shared passion for social VR and human connection.

Diversity is a strength.** Europeans and Asians can meet, exchange ideas, share cultures, and build friendships across borders in ways that would otherwise be much more difficult. Social VR should bring people together, regardless of nationality, language, or background.

Credit where credit is due: **Shane Harris and the original AltspaceVR team have clearly done their homework.** Learning from past mistakes, understanding what worked and what didn't, and applying those lessons is exactly how a virtual community can evolve and improve.

The result is an opportunity to build something more mature, inclusive, creative, and welcoming — a place where veterans can feel at home again and newcomers can find their own place in the community.

Different worlds, different backgrounds, one community. That's the real potential of social VR.** 🥽🌍🤝
This is one of the best Social platforms!!
Really cool worlds and very nice community!
